track.why: Only route with text on the peak. The line runs from the Berry Patch connector onto the Snowgrass Flats trail (passes our trailhead pin within ~100 m), up to the PCT, to the 7,190 ft spur junction (matches our climbers-path junction pin) then the spur to the summit (61 m from our pin). Matches SummitPost standard route text. File dated 2013-09-15 (September, in season). One-way ascent of 42 points ending at the summit; the start is ~800 m west of our trailhead pin because the file starts at the adjacent Berry Patch trailhead.
